card.name: Last digit of numbers in dosing tables
card.fires_on: The final digit (mostly 1 or 9) of a two- or three-digit number inside a dosing or weight-band table, just before a unit such as mL, kg, mg or lbs.

modes.label: Digit 1 starting a band
modes.description: The digit 1 ends a number that opens a new weight or dose range, such as 51 or 101.
modes.example: 0 mL 250 mL IV bag 10<<1>> kg and above 150 mL

modes.label: Digit 9 ending a band
modes.description: The digit 9 ends a number just under a round value, in a range or counter.
modes.example: 60 mL/min to less than 90 mL/min 600 mg Every 6 hours 30 mL/min to 5<<9>> mL/min 300 mg Every

card.plain: It fires on the last digit of a number in a dose or weight table, usually a 1 or 9 at the edge of a range.
